entries.rationale: FsusUI adapter typing changed without a visual budget.
Canonical task-page header hierarchy replaces local heading wrappers.
Identity settings adopt canonical ResourceList, EmptyState and DangerZone primitives.
PublicShell owns search and authentication affordances.
Consumer shell CSS ownership is reduced without changing editorial composition.
Typed page kinds replace route-name visual branching.
Identity and admin frames intentionally separate geometry and density.
CSS ownership splits by frame while preserving the authorized frame geometry.
Account header controls use 40px desktop and 44px mobile targets plus the canonical theme affordance.
Frame-owned motion removes global out-in blanking and preserves focus continuity.

Chromium baselines recapture the shipped compact FsusUI task-page header, compact admin empty-state density, locale-activated dashboard fixture copy, and the home main-column editorial eyebrow instead of a duplicated site-hero header, after chrome-linux snapshot removal.

Non-contract account/admin task-page headers adopt the FsusUI title-only form (optional description removed) so the H1 is the single visual focus; the three pages whose descriptions are required by page-governance checkers (user comments, integrity, anonymous account governance) keep their contract copy.

Settings uses one header save authority and shared task-section grammar; sibling flat sections replace nested brand panels, and helper metadata follows the 12/14/16px ladder. The canonical settings screenshot target covers the complete workspace instead of only its header.
